title: Entropies of compact subsets and supported measures
summary: Let $(X,T)$ be a topological dynamical system and $(\mathcal M(X),T_*)$ be its induced system. For a non-empty compact subset $K\subset X$, we define $\mathcal M(K)$ as the set of Borel probability measures supported on $K$. In this paper, we systematically study the relationship between various entropies of $(T,K)$ and of $(T_*,\mathcal M(K))$. We show that: \begin{equation*} \begin{aligned} & h_{\mathrm{top}}^{\mathrm{UC}}(T,K)>0 \iff h_{\mathrm{top}}^{\mathrm{UC}}(T_*,\mathcal{M}(K))=\infty, \qquad &h_{\mathrm{top}}^{P}(T,K)>0\iff h_{\mathrm{top}}^{P}(T_*,\mathcal{M}(K))>0, \qquad…
